verdict.rationale: Check is a payroll API platform. It could plausibly offer background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: webhooks that push event notifications, a CLI usable in user-built scripts and CI/CD pipelines, and an MCP server that agents on the user's own servers can call. None of these is a first-party feature for setting up automations that the product runs autonomously in the background, such as recurring scheduled jobs or triggered workflows. Building blocks and user-side scheduling earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
